name: Custom Pose Parameterization
definition: A differentiable pose representation for optimization that avoids orthogonality constraints, rotation-translation dependency, and translation-focal length entanglement by using a world-to-camera transformation parameterized by a quaternion, scale, 2D translation, and perspective distortion factor.
summary: Custom Pose Parameterization is a differentiable camera representation using quaternions and screen-space values that avoids orthogonality constraints and translation-focal length entanglement for linear optimization.
